description: This file is a PHP source file for the SuiteCRM system's administrative diagnostics module. It contains code to gather system information, dump database schemas and content, check file integrity via MD5 hashes, gather configuration details, copy logs, and package diagnostics into a ZIP archive, providing a comprehensive health check for the CRM instance.

methods.name: sodUpdateProgressBar
methods.description: Updates the progress bar based on item weight and progress percentages.

methods.name: array_as_table
methods.description: Converts an array of data into an HTML table with a header.

methods.name: getFullTableDump
methods.description: Dumps the full contents and schema of a specified database table into an HTML formatted string.

methods.name: deleteDir
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and its contents.

methods.name: prepareDiag
methods.description: Initializes diagnostic process, sets up directories, and displays progress interface.

methods.name: executesugarlog
methods.description: Copies SugarCRM log file to diagnostic directory.

methods.name: executephpinfo
methods.description: Generates a PHP info page and saves it in the diagnostic directory.

methods.name: executeconfigphp
methods.description: Saves current application's configuration array to a file for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: execute_sql
methods.description: Performs database schema and data dumps, and gathers database info as configured.

methods.name: executebeanlistbeanfiles
methods.description: Checks the existence of bean list and bean files, outputs status.

methods.name: executemd5
methods.description: Performs MD5 hash comparison between current files and stored checksums.

methods.name: executevardefs
methods.description: Generates an HTML report of vardefs and schema definitions.

methods.name: finishDiag
methods.description: Compresses all diagnostic files into a ZIP archive and provides download and delete links.
